info.title: Job Board APIs
info.description: The **Job Board API** provides a comprehensive set of endpoints for managing job postings, applications and more...

get.description: Retrieves a specific application by its unique identifier.

delete.description: Deletes an application by its ID.

get.description: Retrieves a list of applications submitted by the currently logged-in user.
Retrieves all applications submitted for a specific job.

post.description: Allows a user to submit a job application.

put.description: Updates the information of an existing application.
Updates the status of an application to 'Accepted'.
Updates the status of an application to 'Removed'.

get.description: Retrieves a paginated list of users based on the given filter and pagination parameters.
Retrieves the current user Info.
Retrieves a single user by their unique identifier.

delete.description: Deletes a user account by its unique identifier.

post.description: Creates a new user account with the provided information.

put.description: Updates the information of an existing user.

post.description: Authenticates a user using their credentials and returns an access token.

get.description: Sends a confirm email link or code to the user's registered email address.

post.description: Generates a new access token using a valid refresh token.

get.description: Confirms a user's email address using a confirmation code or token.

put.description: Sends a password reset link or code to the user's registered email address.

get.description: Validates the password reset token or code before allowing password change.

post.description: Resets the user's password using the provided reset token and new password.

put.description: Sends a confirm email code to the user's registered email address.
Sends a confirm email code to the user's changed email address.
Verify the new email and change the user email to the new one.
Changes the password of an existing user account.

get.description: Returns a list of all roles defined in the system.
Retrieves detailed information about a specific role by its ID.

delete.description: Deletes an existing role by ID.

get.description: Fetches role assignment details for a specific user.

put.description: Updates the roles assigned to a specific user.

post.description: Creates a new role in the system with the specified permissions.

put.description: Updates the details of an existing role.

get.description: Fetches claim assignment details for a specific user.

put.description: Updates the claims assigned to a specific user.

get.description: Retrieves a specific bookmark using its unique identifier.

delete.description: Deletes a specific bookmark by its unique identifier.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of all bookmarks. Requires admin role.
Retrieves all bookmarks associated with a specific user.

post.description: Creates a new bookmark entry in the system.

get.description: Retrieves a specific category using its unique identifier.

delete.summary: Delete a category by ID (Admin only)
delete.description: Deletes a specific category by its unique identifier. Requires admin privileges.

get.description: Returns a list of all categories stored in the system.

post.description: Creates a new category entry in the system.

put.description: Updates the details of an existing category. Requires admin privileges.

get.description: Retrieves a paginated list of companies based on the specified query parameters.
Retrieves the details of a company by its unique identifier.

delete.description: Deletes a company identified by its unique ID.

get.description: Returns a list of all companies. Restricted to Admin role.

post.description: Creates a new company with the provided details.

put.description: Updates the details of an existing company.

get.description: This EndPoint fetch Country Details. Country must exist
Returns a list of all countries stored in the system.
Returns a paginated list of jobs based on the query parameters.
Retrieves detailed information about a specific job identified by its ID.

delete.description: Deletes a job identified by its unique ID.

get.description: Returns a list of skills associated with a specific job identified by its JobId.
Returns a list of categories associated with a specific job identified by its JobId.

post.description: Creates a new job entry with the provided job details.

put.description: Updates an existing job with the provided information.

get.description: Retrieves all jobs posted by a specific company identified by its ID.
Retrieves detailed information about a specific skill identified by its ID.

delete.description: Deletes a skill identified by its unique ID.

get.description: Returns a list of all skills available in the system.

post.description: Adds a new skill to the system with the provided details.

put.description: Updates an existing skill with the provided information.
